event_context.format: Large Cursor India Roadshow in Hyderabad: demos, talks, networking. Professional builders preferred.
prioritize: Working professionals (engineers, founders, PMs, designers) who use Cursor in real work
Concrete answers about what they build — shipped products, production workflows, agents, MCP
People with credible company + job title and LinkedIn/GitHub
deprioritize: Students / college-only profiles (even if they slipped past heuristics)
Empty, one-word, or pure learn-only answers with no building signal
Obvious AI-slop boilerplate with no personal project detail
event_context.notes: No hard capacity cut in this run — recommend accept/decline only. Prefer professionals. Missing GitHub alone is not a decline if answers + LinkedIn are strong.
